name: Camera Capture
description: Captures a photo or a 10-second video using the browser camera and saves it as a file in the public files directory.
project_description: Camera Capture provides a single form, at /camera-capture, that uses the browser's getUserMedia/MediaRecorder APIs to take a photo or record a short (10 second) video from the device camera and save it into Drupal's public file system. The photo is stored as a PNG and the video as a WebM, with server-generated file names. It targets EKYC and identity-verification style flows where the user should capture media live rather than upload a pre-existing file, and works across desktop, laptop, tablet, and mobile on browsers that support the MediaDevices API (Edge, Chrome, Firefox, Safari). Because getUserMedia requires a secure context, capture works only over HTTPS or on http://localhost. The module ships no settings, no permissions of its own, no services, and no config; it is a routing entry, a FormBase form (CameraCaptureForm), and one JS behavior (js/camera.js).
